seoTitle: Finding a toilet, a tap or a shower in Lisbon
seoText: General map apps are built around businesses and directions, so the free and public things — a toilet in a park, a drinking fountain on a square, a shower at a beach — are the ones they cover least well. That is the gap this map fills. In Lisbon it currently holds 254 public toilets and 539 places to refill a bottle, each with whatever the source records about cost, opening hours and access. It works the same way in every city you travel to next.
highlight: Lisbon is a city to carry a bottle in: it has 2.1 times more public drinking water points than public toilets — 539 against 254.
